sections.heading: Houses for crews near Bridgwater
sections.body_markdown:

sections.heading: Major projects near Bridgwater
sections.body_markdown:

- **A39 Bridgwater to Cannington Resurfacing and Drainage Improvements** is 3 miles from the town. It is a road contract worth £6.15m awarded to Kier Highways Limited, starting in 2026, with an estimated 18 workers away from home.

sections.heading: Hotel vs whole house cost for a crew of 6
sections.body_markdown:
A typical local hotel rate in Bridgwater is £95 per person per night. Our lowest local price is £29.50 per person per night, with bills included. For a crew of 6, that works out as follows.

| Period | Hotel | Whole house | Saving |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 weeks (28 nights) | £15,960 | £4,956 | £11,004 (69%) |
| 12 weeks (84 nights) | £47,880 | £14,868 | £33,012 (69%) |

The hotel figure is a typical local rate, not a quote, and your saving depends on the house and dates. The house price already covers energy, water, Wi-Fi, council tax and cleaning, so there are no extra room charges or parking fees to add. Crews also cook their own meals, which cuts subsistence spend compared with eating out every night.

sections.heading: What's included
sections.body_markdown:
Every house comes ready for a working crew:

- All bills: gas, electricity and water

- Council tax
- Regular cleaning
- A full kitchen with cooker, fridge freezer and microwave
- Shared living space so the crew can unwind together
- Washing machine for work clothes

You pay one price per person per night. There are no deposits for utilities and no meter readings for your site team to worry about.

sections.heading: Parking and vans

Parking matters more than almost anything else for site crews. Near Bridgwater, 2 of our 3 houses have space for vans:

sections.heading: How booking works
sections.body_markdown:
Booking is simple and quick:

- Send us the crew size, the dates and the site location, or call 0800 088 4225.
- We send a same-day quote with the houses that fit, distances to site and the price per person per night.
- You book weekly or monthly, and you can extend as the programme moves.
- Approved business accounts can pay on 14 to 30 day credit terms.
- Once your crew moves in, our UK team is on hand 24/7 for anything that goes wrong.

Because StaysDirect is the direct operator, there is no agency markup on the price you pay.
